title: opendevelopment-space
description:
Home of the Open Development Space website.

Built with React and Vite. The website is available on GitHub. We promise something of note will be put here in the future.
There is nothing to show here, but there will be soon.

title: modernDash
description:
Built to be modular. Built to be easy.

A full-screen cli dashboard built with rich python. A welcome banner, an animated ASCII aquarium, the current conditions with an hourly rain bar chart, a 7-day forecast and a clock. Weather comes from Open-Meteo (https://open-meteo.com).

title: resKern
description:
Rust based kernel to learn with.

Building a kernel in rust where there is no standard library to use so you have to learn a lot from scratch. Follow the organization wide security documentation. Currently AGPL but this is subject to change. This project uses nightly.

title: srch
description: srch is a simple CLI search engine. Query anything and get the top result and more.
